mismatch.message: unsupported level change: makelevel: load_special() has no loader for special level "tut-2"

summary: The admitted v65 tutorial setup reaches The Tutorial level 2 at segment 0, step 41. C selects dat/tut-2.lua and builds its special level; JavaScript has no tut-2 loader, so makelevel() stops with the missing-loader error.

source.branch: The Tutorial level 2 is selected as a special level by mklev.c:makelevel() and loaded through mkmaze.c:makemaz() and sp_lev.c:load_special(). dat/tut-2.lua initializes a solid-fill maze level, adds its fixed map, lit region, up stair, keybinding engraving, visible magic portal, and non-diggable boundary.
callers: nethack-c/upstream/src/mklev.c:makelevel() selects the tutorial special-level prototype and calls makemaz().
nethack-c/upstream/src/sp_lev.c:load_special() loads dat/tut-2.lua in the special-level Lua state.
js/mklev.js:makelevel() resolves the special-level prototype and throws because SPECIAL_LEVEL_LOADERS lacks tut-2; js/tutorial_startup.js invokes the tutorial startup loader for tut-1 only.
dependencies: Existing js/mklev.js descriptor API for level_init, level_flags, map, region, stair, engraving, trap, and non_diggable.
The special-level engraving calls nh.eckey("up"); the port must derive the active extended-command key from command-binding state.

evidence: The accepted v65 baseline reports 41/70 screens and cursors and 6310/6333 RNG calls before the step-41 unsupported-level-change stop. Manifest SHA-256 f70f71815d735aaadd8aa21727e89bcd4bb2e8a413934e250039eb93976d64de; recording SHA-256 630e740c3f1ede6f2185ebeb20a5a33bbf76a6c94ad7426810d2c3f2be789d0a.

The recipe enters Wizard-mode level 2 with #wizlevelport, then invokes #wizmap. At step 41 C displays the arrival message and starts special-level generation; JavaScript raises UnsupportedLevelChangeError because the registry omits tut-2.

The complete dat/tut-2.lua program is 27 lines: solidfill initialization, maze-level flags, a fixed map, a lit region, an up stair, a burn engraving using nh.eckey("up"), a seen magic portal, and non_diggable().

mklev.c:makelevel() dispatches Is_special() levels to makemaz(); mkmaze.c:makemaz() appends .lua and calls load_special(); sp_lev.c:load_special() executes the selected program and its generation post-processing.

js/mklev.js:makelevel() stops when SPECIAL_LEVEL_LOADERS lacks tut-2. The tutorial startup path imports loadTutorialLevel directly for tut-1, and ensureSpecialLevelLoaders() does not register a tut-2 loader.
